title: Project Hail Mary – Stellar Navigation Chart
summary: Project Hail Mary – Stellar Navigation Chart is an interactive web-based visualization tool that allows users to explore and navigate through stellar data, inspired by Andy Weir's sci-fi novel. The project likely utilizes ESA's Gaia mission data to render star positions and enable exploration of space navigation concepts.
problem_solved: Makes complex astronomical data accessible and interactive for space enthusiasts to understand stellar navigation
why_valuable: Combines science fiction inspiration with real ESA data to create an engaging educational tool for understanding our galaxy
